units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
नाहं देहो नेन्द्रियाण्यन्तरङ्गो नाहंकारः प्राणवर्गो न बुद्धिः ।
दारापत्यक्षेत्रवित्तादिदूरः साक्षी नित्यः प्रत्यगात्मा शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am not the body, the senses, the inner faculty, the ego, the vital breaths, or the intellect. I am far removed from spouse, children, land, wealth, and the rest: I am the eternal witness, the inward Self, Śiva.

gloss.en: not; repeated before the listed identities
I am Śiva, the auspicious Self

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
रज्ज्वज्ञानाद्भाति रज्जौ यथाहिः स्वात्माज्ञानादात्मनो जीवभावः ।
आप्तोक्त्याहिभ्रान्तिनाशे स रज्जुर्जीवो नाहं देशिकोक्त्या शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: Just as, through ignorance of the rope, a snake appears on the rope, so from ignorance of the Self the Self seems to be an individual soul. When the snake-delusion is dispelled by a trusted statement, what remains is the rope; by the teacher’s statement, I am not the limited soul: I am Śiva.

gloss.en: from ignorance of one’s own Self
I am Śiva, the auspicious Self

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
आभातीदं विश्वमात्मन्यसत्यं सत्यज्ञानानन्दरूपे विमोहात् ।
निद्रामोहात्स्वप्नवत्तन्न सत्यं शुद्धः पूर्णो नित्य एकः शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: Through delusion, this unreal universe appears in the Self, whose nature is reality, knowledge, and bliss. Like a dream produced by sleep-delusion, it is not ultimately real. I am pure, complete, eternal, one—Śiva.

gloss.en: I am Śiva, the auspicious Self

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
नाहं जातो न प्रवृद्धो न नष्टो देहस्योक्ताः प्राकृताः सर्वधर्माः ।
कर्तृत्वादिश्चिन्मयस्यास्ति नाहंकारस्यैव ह्यात्मनो मे शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I was not born, did not grow, and was not destroyed; all these natural conditions are declared to belong to the body. Agency and the rest belong to the ego, not to my conscious Self. I am Śiva.

gloss.en: I am Śiva, the auspicious Self

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
मत्तो नान्यत्किंचिदत्रास्ति विश्वं सत्यं बाह्यं वस्तु मायोपकॢप्तम् ।
आदर्शान्तर्भासमानस्य तुल्यं मय्यद्वैते भाति तस्माच्छिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: There is nothing here apart from me. The universe, taken as a real external object, is fashioned by māyā. It appears in non-dual me like an image shining within a mirror; therefore I am Śiva.

gloss.en: I am Śiva, the auspicious Self

units.label: Closing colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ अद्वैतपञ्चरत्नं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus is completed the Advaitapañcaratnam composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, disciple of the venerable Govinda Bhagavat, the revered teacher who has renounced all, and supreme among wandering ascetics.

gloss.en: whose feet are worthy of worship
